performance.verdict: Google burning $507 with zero conversions; Meta efficient but pipeline intake unverified.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $507.73 over 28 days with 0 conversions and 0 leads; 49.35% spend increase last 7d compounds a confirmed zero-return leak.
5 overdue SOW milestones (Stripe QA Jul 20, GHL Build Aug 31, Stack Re-Test Aug 31, Paid Landing Pages Aug 31, UGC Batch Aug 31) — all unconfirmed completed, blocking attribution and scaling.

GHL shows 182 contacts but only 138 opportunities created and 0 won; 28-day lead count is 140 — ~4 leads are not entering the pipeline at all, and 0 appointments suggests intake or follow-up is stalled.
GBP actions dropped 90.48% week-over-week (from ~21 to ~2 in last 7d); last 7 series days show 0 GBP actions — profile may have gone dark or lost visibility.

Meta CPL is holding near $16 baseline (28d CPL $16.01, cpl_7d_pct +1.97%) with 3-day lead signal of 4 leads (Sep 12–14) vs 22 leads prior 3 days (Sep 9–11) — weekend zero-spend pattern explains dip, not fatigue.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads immediately — $507.73 spent over 28 days with confirmed 0 conversions and 0 leads.
